statement: The relative pro2 completion has a free rank4 kernel K over Q/O2(Q) of order18. The first new Zassenhaus refinement beyond the N-class-two tower is B/D7(K), with degree6 layer dimension690 and gamma3N image dimension240. Exhausting all152 generators of the lower N-centralizer proves the two earlier selected central representatives from D.27 and D.29 nongenuine, using their retained G6 data jointly with K/D6. A new central replacement solves the28 simultaneous Z4 and degree6 constraints and passes a direct2,944,468-letter cusp check in both complete Magnus models. It extends compatibly over the entire D29 tower, all odd relative pro-p kernels, and D28's mixed quotient. The exact new two-primary kernel is class3, with third lower-central subgroup C2^240.
notes: K has rank4 and N index32. Restricted dimensions through6 are4,10,20,70,204,690. N image below degree6 has order2^303, Frattini dimensions225+78; fixed dimensions117 and42, connecting rank7, liftable quotient35, complete fixed subgroup generators152. Full central correction rank648 rises to654 and both earlier selected targets remain outside; explicit separating functionals are saved. Joint use of G6 is essential because K/D6 does not retain all G2 data. Cusp order48 at both stages excludes multiplier freedom. The new seed keeps all prior homology/right-centralizer and G3 data, but replaces central coordinates explicitly. The15 Z4 plus13 gamma3N conditions have rank28. Its multiplier is1; the2,944,468-letter B word collapses to562,814 rank4 letters and is checked in both models. The exact common quotient has order576*2^753 and combined finite quotient order576*2^9843. Future stable corrections lie in D8(K), so the action extends to P2/(closure(gamma3N) intersect D7(K)) with third central subgroup C2^240 and fourth trivial. Full genuine realization of the replacement and the CM pair remains unresolved. Earlier finite certificates are preserved separately. Agent A independently audited and reran all three programs, including both joint-model word checks and exact common-quotient compatibility. The retained G3 conjugators are separately selected odd-primary fibre-product components; the displayed discrete two-primary word is not claimed to have the same G3 abelianization. D.31 subsequently supplies a degree-seven central replacement with the same homology and CM data. Its canonical map to this target has kernel C2^1620, but the induced action explicitly differs from this recorded central representative in H^(1); no retention of these old central coordinates is asserted.
